claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement and no generate gate. Milliseconds are CITED: catalog / state bytes billed at the MEASURED per-stream rates from ECONOMICS_CALIBRATION (weight_codes 0.547282 ms/GB, broadcast_aux 0.000, activation 2.906132), never the organ average. Recurrent state S is resident ACTIVATION. This is an OPPORTUNITY_BOUND_ON_PERFECT_SUCCESS, not a measured speedup. Capability is UNMEASURED for every family. Coefficients are the same seeded STATIC map of real residual-stream X the multi-step judge used; that map is not W_qkvz and the trained q/k/v trajectory is UNMEASURED. Held-out is by prompt_id (code:14, code:15). A train figure cannot be reported as held-out. A missing corpus raises rather than synthesising X (NNS-001). An absent family is a refuse, not a pass.

conditional_recurrence.unfairness: k-means on the scored hold (k,v,decay,beta). Perfect assignment to the true cluster (oracle router, cannot exist at runtime, billed at broadcast_aux = 0.000 ms/GB). True q is kept as the readout. ALL K rules are billed.
conditional_recurrence.why: Perfect routing into 128 regimes still leaves one-step state relative L2 0.650 against bar 0.01. Billing all 128 rules is 1.0385 ms cited (1.1775 removed − 0.139 added) against a 1.813 ms residual. A real router is strictly weaker than this oracle, and the named beta-skip candidate removes zero catalog bytes.

generated_coefficients.unfairness: Shared generator is PCA of residual-stream X. Codes are a least-squares map fitted on the scored hold tokens (perfect per-block codes, no runtime constraint). The interpolating operating point uses a generator fitted on the hold X itself.
generated_coefficients.why: Even a hold-interpolating generator whose rank equals the scored token count (r=1024) only removes qkvz weight_codes (1.1707 ms cited) and does not clear the 1.813 ms residual. At the claimed rank 256 the transition is not reconstructed (coeff relative L2 0.364, one-step state 0.320, bar 0.01). A fair runtime generator is strictly weaker.

budget_actually_needed.note: d_state_for_store_bar is a LOWER BOUND on the dimension of a store of this trajectory (relative L2 <= 0.01). A recurrence that has to GENERATE the trajectory cannot be smaller. The linear SSM at every swept d_state fails the transition bar.

learned_recurrence.unfairness: PCA basis of vec(S) is fitted on the scored hold trajectory (sequence-specific, cannot exist as a runtime basis without storing it). Linear A,B are least-squares on that same trajectory. No parameter-budget cap was applied.
learned_recurrence.why: The recorded S trajectory on hold fills rank (store-bar d_state 520 vs named 16). A linear SSM at d_state=16 has one-step state relative L2 0.5472422293808189 and unroll 0.5477122699830574 against bar 0.01. Scaling in_proj to d_state=520 bills 5.367 ms cited added against 1.1988 ms cited removed; the bound -4.1682 ms does not clear the 1.813 ms residual. A fair recurrence is strictly weaker than this oracle.

input.coefficients: seeded STATIC map of X, shader L2 on q/k; not W_qkvz. Same map as DELTANET_MULTISTEP.

price_context.note: Cited from DELTANET_STATE_MACHINE_ECONOMICS, not re-measured. The residual is the gap a NEW lever has to close.

prior.expect: Two of six are already MEASURED_NEGATIVE. The prior on these three is not neutral. A well-supported ORACLE_NEGATIVE is the deliverable: it closes S020 §16 and stops the campaign returning.

purpose: Oracle-first bounds for generated_coefficients, learned_recurrence and conditional_recurrence. If an unfair oracle cannot make the economics work, do not build the real version.
what_this_does_not_prove: Capability. Every family's capability is UNMEASURED.
A generate-identity gate on the sealed residual stream.
That X equals the sealed mixer input (capture_diverse2 is post_attn_norm).
That the seeded STATIC coefficient map is W_qkvz.
A measured speedup. Every millisecond is cited and pro-rated.
A hardware number. gpu_authority is false.
